As shown on Map 1 (Exhibit B), that portion of the project area which has not been conveyed to the United States of America (and which is bounded generally by Binney Street on the North, the Boston and Albany (Grand Junction) Branch Railroad on the West, Main Street on the South and discontinued Sixth Street and Broadway on the East) is hereinafter described as the "MXD District" or "MXD District portion"; and the remaining portion of the project area is hereinafter described as the "remainder of the project area".
(2) Section 102 of the Plan is amended to read as follows: Section 102: Urban Renewal Plan Objectives The Urban Renewal Plan objectives of the project are as follows:
